result.rationale: In sharing mode refreshOAuthTokens returns the raw fetch Response from CALCOM_CREDENTIAL_SYNC_ENDPOINT (diff shows `const response = await fetch(...); return response;`). GoogleCalendarService then does `const res = await refreshOAuthTokens(...); const token = res?.data; token.access_token` — a Response has no `.data`, so sharing-mode Google refresh throws. Hubspot assigns the Response to `hubspotRefreshToken: HubspotToken` and reads its fields, which would be undefined. Both mechanisms are directly visible in the diff.

judged_text: In credential-sharing mode refreshOAuthTokens returns the raw fetch Response from CALCOM_CREDENTIAL_SYNC_ENDPOINT, but GoogleCalendarService reads res?.data (a Gaxios-only property that is undefined on a Response) and HubspotCalendarService types the return as HubspotToken and reads .refresh_token/.expires_in off it. Every sharing-mode Google refresh throws TypeError (token.access_token of undefined) and Hubspot persists undefined/NaN token fields, so the credential-sync feature this PR introduces cannot work at all for those two apps.

adjudication.rationale: The diff introduces `refreshOAuthTokens` which, in credential-sharing mode (`APP_CREDENTIAL_SHARING_ENABLED && CALCOM_CREDENTIAL_SYNC_ENDPOINT && userId`), returns the raw `fetch(...)` result (a standard `Response`) without parsing JSON (`packages/app-store/_utils/oauth/refreshOAuthTokens.ts`). In `GoogleCalendarService`, the caller assumes a Gaxios-style response and does `const token = res?.data;` then reads `token.access_token`/`token.expiry_date` (`packages/app-store/googlecalendar/lib/CalendarService.ts`), which will be `undefined` on a `Response`, causing a runtime error when sharing mode is enabled. Similarly, `HubspotCalendarService` assigns the result of `refreshOAuthTokens(...)` to a `HubspotToken`-typed variable (`packages/app-store/hubspot/lib/CalendarService.ts`), but in sharing mode it will actually be a `Response`, so downstream property reads (e.g., token fields) would be incorrect/broken. This is a concrete behavioral mismatch introduced by the diff.
